### Ballina Arts Centre Meetup 01.04.23 9pm until Midnight

Lá na nAmadáin seems an especially appropriate night to have our first semi-official THENCF social.

Kindly hosted by Paul Cunningham, the new Director of the Ballina Arts centre, this is a good chance for Artists and Art-appreciators alike to hang out and get to know each other.

Paul will be manning the decks so to speak, with guest appearances from anyone who shows up. Feel free to bring your records. The bar will be open.

If you're not sure what THENCF is, don't worry we'll fill you in on the night but if you're into any kind of artistic discipline and are looking for an alternative place to hang out at night, THENCF is for you.

Open from 9pm, make your way upstairs to the bar. See you Saturday.

Love, th'NCF.
